newsitem.title: USA: Emerson, General Signal agree to venture.
newsitem.headline: Emerson, General Signal agree to venture.

text.p: Emerson Electric Co and General Signal Corp have agreed in principle to form a joint venture combining Emerson's Appleton Electric division and General Signal's Electrical Group (GSEG), the companies said Monday.

Emerson will hold a majority interest in the venture, which will have its own board of directors with representatives from both Emerson and General Signal, they said in a news release. Appleton and GSEG will have separate sales forces and will keep individual brand identities in the marketplace. Other terms were not disclosed.

The joint venture will serve the electrical distribution industry with various products, including electrical fittings, connectors, steel outlet boxes, enclosures, controls, plugs, industrial and commercial lighting, direct-current power supplies, fire-stop and heat-trace equipment, industrial signaling and transformers.
Appleton, based in Chicago, manufactures electrical products for hazardous and non-hazardous locations.
GSEG, headquartered in Farmington, Connecticut, includes four businesses serving the electrical distribution market.
